properties.title: Platform Spill, West Cameron Block 9, LA
properties.content: On 15May12, USCG MSU Port Arthur contact NOAA SSC about a release from a platform. Initial report was from a good Samaritan helicopter who saw a sheen and followed it back to a platform. Initial call came in at 13:22 CST. USCG is looking for a trajectory from NOAA.

properties.title: Pipeline Rupture, Near Grand Isle, LA
properties.content: At 1224 CST on 17MAR, USCG Sector New Orleans contact NOAA SSC about a thick black sheen (1 mi by 1 mi by 0.5 cm) discovered by USCG personnel working in the vicinity. A jack-up rig dropped their spuds onto a pipeline earlier this morning causing an uncontrolled release of crude oil. The release has been for at least 3 hours and continues unsecured. Trajectory analysis has been requested.
